svg.title: Hebbian Body
svg.desc: Following note 7 of the Sixty-Six Notes: each modular prompt is a cell, a neurone. Cells that fire together (are useful in the same moments) wire together, and their links strengthen until they form an organ, which is a role. Organs together form a body, and the body is a sangha of agents of reciprocity acting as one hive mind. Roles are found from use rather than designed.
svg.text: cells = modular prompts · fire together → wire together → an organ (a role)
